Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual proposal for one explorable 16:9 pixel-art game scene, not an infographic. Create a NEW exterior of 'La forja y fundición' in an early industrial British factory district. Reference image is ONLY for visual style and overhead adventure camera: match its dense handcrafted pixel art, warm amber sunset, dark iron, soot-stained red brick, oil lanterns and readable game layout. Do not copy the mine headframe or mine buildings.
Composition: ONE single full-frame landscape view, 16:9, moderately elevated 3/4 adventure view like the reference. A compact brick ironworks occupies the upper half; the lower 40 percent is a clear, accessible cobblestone yard for walking. Main entrance at center-right: a HUMAN-SIZED wooden double door reinforced in dark iron, two wall lanterns, warm light at the threshold; door tall enough for approximately two 60px-at-648-height game sprites, not a cathedral arch. Two brick smokestacks behind the roof; visible warm furnace glow through modest arched windows. Left edge has an open lane visibly continuing toward the mine and industrial district. Props hug edges: short stacks of iron bars, a few casting mould boxes, a small wooden handcart loaded with iron ingots, barrels and crates. Low iron fence at far right, no blocked walkable center. Background skyline connects to the same industrial town, subtle smoke. Room/building scale feels intimate and playable, not monumental.
For scale only: one small chibi adventure hero in a wide straw hat, cream shirt, brown vest and trousers, near the yard center, facing the door. Full visible height roughly 8 percent of image height. NO other people. Hero clear consistent small game sprite, not realistic adult. Polished crisp pixel clusters, rich texture, exact readable perspective, no smooth painted look. No mine headframe, no elevator, no modern electrical machinery, no car, no HUD, no text, no labels, no arrows, no diagrams, no watermark. This is a scene proposal; do NOT depict puzzle panels or puzzle interactions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: visual proposal for one explorable 16:9 pixel-art game scene, not an infographic. Create a NEW INTERIOR workshop of the same compact early industrial red brick ironworks, 'La forja y fundición'. Image 1 (mine winding house) is a STYLE AND CAMERA reference: crisp rich pixel art, warm lantern lighting, close human-scaled room, readable floors. Image 2 (old forge) is ONLY reference for brick furnace, ironworking material palette and glowing embers. Improve its playable layout: avoid the oversized industrial press. This interior belongs to a small workshop, not a vast factory cathedral.
Composition: ONE full-frame 16:9 landscape game screen, front cutaway with slightly raised adventure camera so the floor has depth, no roof obstructing view. Open wooden exit door at far LEFT with a sliver of warm sunset and cobblestone yard visible. Soot-dark brick rear wall, sturdy timber roof beams and small arched windows. Rear center-left is a medium brick forge/furnace with a low arch and glowing orange embers, simple manual bellows at its side and masonry chimney. Rear center-right is a heavy wooden moulding/workbench holding a small rectangular sand casting mould, a few ingots and tongs. At far right a stone water trough and wooden bucket, all behind the walkable strip. A compact anvil on a stump near center, wall racks with restrained hand tools, neatly stored bars and crates at the room edges. The lower 35 percent remains a clear continuous stone floor walking strip, accessible left-to-right with enough depth to reach the workbench. No giant machinery, hanging hazard, molten metal pouring into walkway or underground abyss.
Include TWO proportionally matched chibi game sprites for scale only, full visible height approximately 9 percent of frame height: straw-hatted hero in cream shirt, brown vest and trousers at left-center, and Cort the ironworker beside the anvil at right-center, SAME pixel height and head-to-body ratio as the hero, stocky, dark hair and moustache, rolled cream sleeves, dark red shirt accents and leather apron. No other people. Warm flickering amber furnace light and soft cool highlights from small windows, dark iron, red brick and weathered timber. High quality dense crisp pixel art matching reference, no blurry painterly look. No text, no labels, no title, no HUD, no arrows, no UI, no puzzle diagram or controls. This is only an interior scene proposal, no puzzle implemented.
